adjudication.rationale: The new TRPC endpoint `addGuests` accepts `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` in `addGuests.schema.ts` with no `.max(...)` (or similar) bound, and the handler (`addGuests.handler.ts`) performs `attendees.createMany` using the provided list (after only filtering existing/blacklisted emails) with no cap. Authorization explicitly allows any existing attendee (`const isAttendee = !!booking.attendees.find((attendee) => attendee.email === user.email);`) to call it, not just the organizer/admin. After updating, it calls `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)`, which iterates over `calendarEvent.attendees` and sends emails per attendee, enabling a single request to create many attendee rows and trigger many outgoing emails. No rate limiting/throttling is shown in the diff. This is a verifiable security/resource-abuse vector introduced by the change.
